raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week General Fitness Programme for Post-MI Client (Moderate Intensity)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general conditioning with medically cleared moderate-intensity resistance training and cardio while avoiding high HR and Valsalva"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro & Foundation - Cardio & Mobility":
        warmup:
          treadmill walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest press machine 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_zone:
          stationary bike 10 minutes steady-state, keep HR ~65-70% of age-predicted max
        cooldown:
          leg and hip stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Stability & Light Total Body":
        warmup:
          arm circles and thoracic mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          overhead press machine 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_zone:
          elliptical or rowing machine 6 minutes light-moderate
        cooldown:
          full-body stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Endurance & Mobility":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated leg extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          assisted chin/row combo 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        mobility_circuit:
          hip hinge, shoulder pass-throughs, ankle mobility 6 minutes
        cooldown:
          breathing & relaxation 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression A":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg extension 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          cable row 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          chest press machine 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_zone:
          bike 12 minutes steady-state
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Balance & Core":
        warmup:
          dynamic moves 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          standing balance with support 3x30s each side
          Pallof press (standing, light) 3x12 rpe 6.5
        cardio_zone:
          rower 6 minutes
        cooldown:
          cat-cow and child pose 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Light Circuit":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg press 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          seated row 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          chest fly or push station 3x12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
        mobility_circuit:
          6 minutes
        cooldown:
          breathing 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength & Endurance Progression":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg extension 4x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          chest press machine 4x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cardio_zone:
          treadmill incline walk 8 minutes, HR target below 70% age-pred max
        cooldown:
          lower body stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Core Stability":
        warmup:
          dynamic trunk twists 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bird-dog 3x12 each side rpe 6
          side plank 3x20s each side
          standing anti-rot 3x12 each side
        cardio_zone:
          elliptical 6 minutes
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full-Body Matrix (no max lifts)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg press 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat pulldown 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          overhead press machine 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing + stretch 6 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Tempo Cardio & Strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg extension 4x10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          cable row 4x10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          chest press machine 4x10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
        cardio_zone:
          treadmill steady-state 10 minutes, maintain HR under 115 bpm
        cooldown:
          mobility 6 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility & Posture":
        warmup:
          mobility flow 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridge march 3x12 rpe 6
          face pulls light 3x12
          hip external rotator 3x12
        cardio_zone:
          rower 6 minutes
        cooldown:
          stretch sequence 6 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Maintenance Primer":
        warmup:
          incline walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg press 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated row 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          resistance band chest press 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing & relax 6 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Consolidation & Endurance":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg extension 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable row 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          chest press machine 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cardio_zone:
          treadmill walk at moderate pace 12 minutes
        cooldown:
          full-body stretch 6 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Core & Mobility Deep":
        warmup:
          dynamic mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead bug 3x12
          pallof press 3x12
          bird-dog with tempo 3x12
        cardio_zone:
          elliptical 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 6 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Light Total-Body Circuit":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg press 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat pulldown 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder press machine 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing & stretch 6 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Integrated Conditioning":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg extension 4x12 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          cable row 4x12 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          chest press machine 4x12 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
        cardio_zone:
          bike 12 minutes steady-state, HR under 115 bpm
        cooldown:
          mobility 6 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Stability & Balance":
        warmup:
          dynamic moves 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute bridges 3x15
          single-leg stance hold 2x30s each leg
          anti-rotation press 3x12
        cardio_zone:
          rower 6 minutes
        cooldown:
          stretch 6 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Recovery Focus":
        warmup:
          breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg press 4x12 rpe 6
          seated row 4x12 rpe 6
          banded pull-apart 3x15
        cooldown:
          longer relaxation 8 minutes

Notes:
- HR targets: never prescribe zones above 70% age-pred max (~115 bpm for this client). All workouts maintain moderate intensity; monitor HR and RPE; stop or reduce if symptoms occur.
- No max lifts, no Valsalva maneuvers; exercises use machines, cables, or free weights with strict control to avoid heavy loads.
- Reps/sets are in WPL-AI compliant format: sets first, then reps, with rpe and rest as specified.
- Full gym movements are included with safe alternatives to protect cardiac status. If any exercise triggers discomfort, substitute with low-impact option (e.g., stationary bike, aquatic exercise if available).
- Each week uses 3 training days in Phase 1, 3 in Phase 2, 3 in Phase 3; progression is gradual with increased volume and same or slightly higher RPE but not exceeding safe HR.
